purpose: Determine, for each count and each reported missing relationship in the executive Overall Audit, whether the audit queried the right source and whether its finding is a measurement or an artifact.

access_limitations: No DATABASE_URL, psql client, or Python interpreter is available in this environment.
All database-level facts below are derived from the deployed backend's own read-only telemetry endpoints, not from direct SQL.
Row counts attributed to public.orchid_occurrence and public.research_documents are reported by PR #901's live-schema verification and are NOT independently confirmed here.

root_causes.title: The ten reported missing relationships are a hardcoded constant, not a measurement
root_causes.mechanism: A literal list of all ten relationship names was emitted whenever the expression `missing` was non-empty. `missing` is the set of subsystem completeness rows whose status is warning/stub/error/unknown -- a subsystem health signal with no relationship semantics. No relationship, edge, or join was ever queried to produce this field.
root_causes.proof: In the same live payload, the images metric scores healthy on 5,071,287 rows and oc_graph.kg_edges reports 70,609 edges, while taxonomy_to_images and knowledge_graph_node_edge_integrity are both listed as missing. The report contradicts its own measured inputs.
root_causes.consequence: All ten 'missing relationships' are unproven. The audit could not have distinguished a present relationship from an absent one because it never looked at either.

root_causes.title: Metric source selection is first-existing-wins and silently masks larger corpora
root_causes.mechanism: Candidates are probed in order and the first relation that exists is selected; remaining candidates are never examined. A small legacy, staging, or cache relation appearing earlier in the list therefore hides any larger corpus behind it, and the `checked` array records that no further candidate was even considered.
root_causes.proof: Live telemetry returns occurrences.checked == ['oc_atlas.occurrences'] (count 26) and mycorrhiza.checked == ['oc_mycorrhiza.species_mycorrhiza_unified_endpoint_cache'] (count 1). Both stopped at the first candidate.
root_causes.consequence: Two of the audit's most alarming numbers are reading the wrong relation.

root_causes.title: The audit's 'immediate next actions' are a hardcoded constant
root_causes.mechanism: recommended_next_actions was the fixed list ['Apply BUILD-051 migration.', 'Deploy owner-session backend.', 'Run smoke tests.'] returned on every audit regardless of system state.
root_causes.proof: The owner-session backend is already deployed: all 27 /api/mission-control/owner/* routes are present in the live OpenAPI schema, and POST /owner/session issues a working session against production.
root_causes.consequence: The audit's action list is not a finding and must not be treated as evidence that these actions are outstanding.

root_causes.title: The audit's 'medium confidence' label carries no confidence semantics
root_causes.mechanism: confidence is `'medium' if metrics.get('database_connected') else 'low'`. It reports whether a TCP connection succeeded, nothing about measurement quality or coverage.
root_causes.consequence: 'Medium confidence' should not be read as a graded assessment of the audit's findings.

root_causes.title: The deployed owner-backend smoke test uses a credential transport the backend no longer serves
root_causes.mechanism: POST /owner/session delivers the signed session as an HttpOnly cookie and returns the literal string 'cookie' in the JSON token field. The script treated that literal as a bearer token.
root_causes.proof: Reproduced without credentials: GET /owner/session with 'Authorization: Bearer cookie' returns HTTP 200 {"authenticated": false}; GET /owner/permissions with the same header returns HTTP 401 {"detail": "Invalid owner session"}. Workflow run 32132141402 shows exactly this sequence: PASS owner_session, PASS owner_session_validate, then FAIL 401.
root_causes.consequence: Two checks were false passes and the reported failure was an artifact of the test, not a backend defect. The unauthenticated GET /owner/session returns 200, so a status-code-only assertion passes with no credential at all.

root_causes.title: No CI workflow covers the audit measurement or reporting path
root_causes.mechanism: All 207 workflows are path-filtered and none list app/routers/mission_control.py, app/routers/owner_operations.py, or scripts/smoke_owner_backend.py. scripts/smoke_owner_backend.py had no test file at all.
root_causes.consequence: The transport drift in RC-5 and the fabricated reporting in RC-1 could persist indefinitely without a failing check.

safety_invariants_asserted: No missing-data state was converted into biological absence: unmeasured is a distinct reported state from absent, enforced by test_unmeasured_relationships_are_never_reported_as_missing.
No scientific relationship was fabricated, inferred from taxonomy, or promoted from genus to species level by this work.
Headline metric selection semantics were left unchanged; newly identified candidate relations were appended, not promoted, so no metric definition was silently altered to improve a result.
No production data was mutated. All database facts were obtained from read-only telemetry endpoints.

immediate_next_action_dispositions.note: The audit listed three immediate next actions. All three were emitted from a hardcoded constant (RC-3), not derived from state. Each was independently checked.
